title: DP-MIND: Differentially private memory-guided Long context Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.13132v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-as-a-Service has become a dominant paradigm for accessing large language models without requiring local deployment. However, the process raises severe privacy concerns when user queries may include sensitive or confidential contexts. Differential privacy (DP) provides a principled approach to protecting such inputs, but existing DP inference methods are primarily designed for short- or moderate-context settings and struggle with million-token-scale inputs due to limited context capacity and severe utility degradation under DP perturbation.   In this paper, we propose DP-MIND, a memory-guided framework that scales differentially private inference to million-token contexts. DP-MIND enables private long-context inference by locally perturbing the input and processing it chunk by chunk with a compact memory that preserves task-relevant information across the sequence. translated_title: DP-MIND：差分隐私记忆引导的长上下文推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.13132v1 公告类型：新 摘要：LLM即服务（LLM-as-a-Service）已成为无需本地部署即可访问大语言模型的主流范式。然而，当用户查询可能包含敏感或机密上下文时，这一过程会引发严重的隐私问题。差分隐私（DP）为保护此类输入提供了一种有原则的方法，但现有的DP推理方法主要针对短上下文或中等长度上下文场景设计，由于上下文容量有限以及DP扰动下严重的效用下降，它们难以处理百万token规模的输入。在本文中，我们提出DP-MIND，一种记忆引导的框架，将差分隐私推理扩展到百万token级别的长上下文。DP-MIND通过在本地对输入进行扰动，并利用一个紧凑的记忆机制逐块处理输入，从而实现私有的长上下文推理，该记忆机制能够在整个序列中保留与任务相关的信息。为了使该记忆对DP噪声具有鲁棒性，我们优化了记忆构建……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DP-MIND框架，通过本地扰动输入并利用能保留任务相关信息的紧凑记忆机制逐块处理序列，将差分隐私推理成功扩展到百万token级别的长上下文场景。
en_tdlr: DP-MIND is a memory-guided framework that scales differentially private LLM inference to million-token contexts by locally perturbing inputs and processing them chunk by chunk with a compact memory that preserves task-relevant information while remaining robust to DP noise.
